navigation.title: Find your way around
navigation.body: The sidebar brings presentations and content tools together. Manage prepared files in Presentations.

slides.title: Prepare your slides
slides.body: Add slides, arrange their order, and prepare their appearance with the formatting tools.

content.title: Add content to your presentation
content.body: Find content in the Bible section and add it to your presentation. Media, hymns and other content tools are also in the sidebar.

output.title: Manage screen output
output.body: Show prepared content on a screen output. Review the destination screen and preparation checks before presenting.

help.title: Return to help
help.body: Change the language, open the app map or restart this tour from Settings.

tour.suggestTitle: Would you like to explore this page?

pages.presentations: Open presentations from files, save them, or manage prepared presentations in the library.
pages.slides: Add slides, select and reorder them, then edit content and appearance in the right panel.
pages.bible: Choose a Bible source or import an XML file. Select a book, chapter and verses to add content to your presentation.
pages.media: Find and preview images and videos, then add them to your presentation. Combine several items into a loop slide.
pages.hymns: Import a hymn archive or find a hymn, then turn its lyrics into presentation slides.
pages.countdown: Choose minutes and seconds, prepare the appearance, and add a countdown to your presentation.
pages.screen: Choose a screen capture source and add it as a slide. Selecting a source is different from opening a projection output.
pages.calendar: Schedule prepared presentations on the calendar and reopen them from their entries.
pages.editor: Arrange slide elements on the design canvas. Apply pending draft changes with the existing save controls.
pages.settings: Manage language and app preferences. Reopen page introductions and the short tour from Help.

practice.banner: Practice — separate profile; live output disabled
practice.title: Practice progress
practice.preflight: Technical preflight only. Tasks will be delivered separately.
practice.unreadable: Progress could not be read; last valid state retained.
practice.choose: Choose a task and use the application tools to perform it.
practice.retained: Your slides are retained; exiting never cleans them up automatically.
practice.deleteWarning: Remove only the selected deletion sample. If you changed it, keep it and restart the task.
practice.taskError: The operation could not be recorded. Retry or skip the task.

slide-add.title: Add a slide
slide-add.body: Add a new text slide in Slides.

slide-delete.title: Delete the sample slide
slide-delete.body: Remove the selected deletion sample in Slides. Keep your other slides.

media.title: Add media
media.body: Import an image in Media. The practice image is supplied; use its card to add it to the presentation.

bible.title: Import Bible and add a verse
bible.body: Use local import in Bible. Select the sample Genesis 1:1 and add it to the presentation.

countdown.title: Add a countdown
countdown.body: Choose a duration greater than zero in Countdown and add it to the presentation.

presentations.title: Save to library
presentations.body: Save the practice presentation to the library in Presentations. No external file is written.

hymns.title: Hymns
hymns.body: Click the highlighted sample hymn row. Once its lyrics are added, we will inspect the result.

image-edit.title: You edited the image
image-edit.body: Click the highlighted image slide. We will make two simple changes in the editor panel on the right.

slide-reorder.title: Reorder the slides
slide-reorder.body: Drag the highlighted sample slide onto the other highlighted slide. This single exercise finishes when their positions actually change.

guide.title: Learn step by step
guide.description: Learn by performing actions in a separate practice window.
guide.pilot: The guide covers ten sections and six exercises.
guide.waiting: The target is loading. Wait or exit at any time.
guide.stuck: Stuck? Show the target again to retry, or skip this step. A skipped step is not counted as completed.
guide.jumpWarning: Continue from the selected section. Unperformed actions bypassed by moving forward are skipped, not completed.
guide.error: Progress could not be saved or the guide could not load. Retry; success has not been recorded.
guide.finishedSkipped: You reached the end. Skipped steps are not completed.
guide.shortDescription: Quickly discover the main work areas.

welcome.title: Let’s learn together
welcome.body: You will work in a separate practice profile. Live output is disabled and your real presentation stays unchanged. Follow the highlighted actions in order.

presentations.title: Presentations
presentations.body: Manage your presentations here. We are only introducing this section; next you will create a slide with the real tools.

sidebar.title: Section navigation
sidebar.body: The buttons on the left open the application sections. We will highlight the area you need at each step.

add.title: Add a new slide
add.body: Click the highlighted Add New Slide button. The guide advances when the slide exists.

select.title: Select the sample slide
select.body: Click the highlighted sample slide. Select only this sample; your added slide will be retained.

delete.title: Delete the sample
delete.body: Delete the selected sample with Delete or the highlighted trash icon on the right. Either method is accepted; the other slides are retained.

done.title: Finished
done.body: You reached the end of the guide. Practice changes are retained on exit.

bible-intro.title: Load Bible sources
bible-intro.body: Load a Bible from a local XML file, or search online and select a suitable source to add and use it. This practice uses a safe local sample XML.

media-intro.title: Media
media-intro.body: Find and preview images and videos, then add them to your presentation. Combine several items into a loop slide.

hymns-intro.title: Hymns
hymns-intro.body: In normal mode each stanza becomes a separate slide. In parts mode the stanzas are parts of one slide. We will add our sample in parts mode.

countdown-intro.title: Countdown
countdown-intro.body: Choose minutes and seconds, prepare the appearance, and add a countdown to your presentation.

screen-intro.title: Screen
screen-intro.body: Choose a screen capture source and add it as a slide. Selecting a source is different from opening a projection output.

calendar-intro.title: Calendar
calendar-intro.body: Schedule prepared presentations on the calendar and reopen them from their entries.

editor-intro.title: Editor
editor-intro.body: Images can be edited in the right panel or the Slide Editor. The Slide Editor offers more detailed options and video editing tools. We made two simple image edits in our example.

settings-intro.title: Settings
settings-intro.body: Manage language and app preferences. Reopen page introductions and the short tour from Help.

bible-source.title: Load a source
bible-source.body: Click Import XML. If a source is already open, we will open its management menu.

bible-import.title: Import the sample XML
bible-import.body: Click Import XML in the menu. Only the safe sample source is loaded.

bible-add.title: Add the verse
bible-add.body: Click Add to presentation. We will wait for the verse slide to exist.

media-menu.title: Open the media menu
media-menu.body: Click the highlighted Add Media button.

media-import.title: Load the sample image
media-import.body: Click Select Images. A safe sample image is used instead of a real file picker.

media-add.title: Add the image
media-add.body: Click the plus button below the sample image. We will wait for the image slide.

countdown-duration.title: Set the duration
countdown-duration.body: Set Minutes to 2. Only this field can be edited.

countdown-add.title: Add the countdown
countdown-add.body: Click Add to Slide. We will not start the timer or live output.

save.title: Save the practice presentation
save.body: Click Save to Library. Saving uses only the separate practice profile. We will wait for a successful result.

add-result.title: You created a slide
add-result.body: You created a new slide. This is how slides are prepared in your presentation.

delete-result.title: The sample slide was deleted
delete-result.body: The selected sample was removed. Your other slides are retained.

bible-result.title: You added the verse
bible-result.body: You added the verse to your presentation. This is what the prepared slide looks like.

media-result.title: You added the image
media-result.body: You added the image to your presentation. This is how it looks on the slide.

countdown-result.title: Your countdown is ready
countdown-result.body: You prepared a two-minute countdown slide. This is a static preview; the timer has not started.

save-result.title: Your presentation was saved
save-result.body: You saved your presentation in the practice library. You can reopen it there.

hymns-add.title: Add the sample hymn
hymns-add.body: Click the highlighted sample hymn row. Once its lyrics are added, we will inspect the result.

hymns-result.title: You added the hymn
hymns-result.body: You added the sample hymn lyrics to your presentation. This is what the prepared hymn slide looks like.

image-select.title: Select the sample image
image-select.body: Click the highlighted image slide. We will make two simple changes in the editor panel on the right.

image-fit.title: Fit the whole image
image-fit.body: Click Contain in the editor on the right so the whole image fits inside its frame.

image-grayscale.title: Apply grayscale
image-grayscale.body: Set the Grayscale slider to 100%. You can focus the slider and press End.

image-edit-result.title: You edited the image
image-edit-result.body: You changed the image fit and applied grayscale. This is what the edited image looks like.

hymns-parts.title: The hymn parts
hymns-parts.body: The panel on the right shows the hymn parts. Click the numbered button of the desired part to switch to it. This is an explanation only; you do not need to click a part.

reorder.title: Reorder the slides
reorder.body: Drag the highlighted sample slide onto the other highlighted slide. This single exercise finishes when their positions actually change.

hymns-font.title: Change the hymn font size
hymns-font.body: Change the selected hymn font size in the Font size field on the right. Larger numbers make the text larger; smaller numbers make it smaller. This is an explanation only; no change is required.

image-tools.title: Two ways to edit
image-tools.body: Images can be edited in the right panel or in the Slide Editor opened by the highlighted pencil button. The Slide Editor offers more detailed options and also supports video editing. We will only change fit and grayscale on this sample.

guide.onlyIntroducing: We are only introducing this section; there is no practical task.
guide.restartDetail: Your current presentation and progress will be archived. The new practice starts with a clean presentation and no progress. Your language and library remain.

result.emptyPresentation: There are currently no slides in the presentation.
result.unavailable: The verified result could not be read. Retry; you do not need to repeat the operation.
